text.p: Equisure Inc said Wednesday it entered into a new, multi-year reinsurance underwriting facility, through its Equihot Herverzekering NV subsidiary, with RISC International of Austin, Texas.
Under this facility, Equihot will provide reinsurance to RISC clientele located in Central America, South America and Pacific Rim countries.
This new facility is projected to produce approximately $6 million of annual gross premium during the first 12 months of the contract, increasing to $18 million by the third quarter.

Based in Antwerp, Belgium, and Minneapolis, Equisure, through its Equihot Herverzekering unit, is a reinsurance company engaged primarily in covering the financial and political risks associated with the delivery and warehousing of raw, refined or constructed metal products.
